method: Read1011 additional lines, closing main.rs gaps through2215. Static startup, icon worker/receiver and clipboard-event review.
findings: Icon loader checks PostMessage failure and frees boxed key plus nonnull HICON. This narrows earlier publication-leak findings to specific unchecked search/AI/OCR senders; not every asynchronous sender leaks on failure.

Icon receiver on null State frees boxed key but returns without destroying nonnull icon passed in wparam. Normal receiver replaces/destroys owned old icons and invokes prune_owned_icon_cache; actual prune function remains unread.

Icon worker retries after caught panic using same channel; current dequeued request is not recovered or pending key cleared on that panic. COM initialization repeats after restart without matching uninitialization in reviewed worker. No shell-extension panic fixture run.

Startup directly stores loaded AppSettings and creates fonts from cast sizes; no item_height validation before State use in this initialization. Prior division-by-zero path is not prevented here; further reload paths unread.

Window message wrapper uses catch_unwind but invokes wnd_proc_inner declared unsafe extern system too. Catching panics across that inner ABI boundary needs dedicated compiler/runtime proof; comment alone does not establish recovery. No panic survival claim.

Clipboard text events trim content before unique-content upsert and keep at most500 entries counting pinned rows; pinned entries are exempt from deletion. This is text-history identity/retention, not byte-identical-file deduplication.

Clipboard text storage and memory-event insertion run in detached thread without transaction; rapid changes have independently scheduled database writes and timestamps obtained inside worker. No ordering or atomicity guarantee inferred.

Preview caches can call synchronous shell thumbnail loading on UI path and place preview to right of parent without work-area clamp in reviewed function. No latency/monitor fixture or visual acceptance.
Animation loop flag is set before unchecked PostMessage and remains true if publication fails; next trigger may not repost. Source error path only, no live window teardown reproduction.
limits: No new runtime tests or local production edits; helper/Windows failures remain source findings.
